messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
```text
The kitchen clock ticks at half past four, but the shadows lean like waiting cats.
    A jar of violet stars sits on the counter, and the stars blink when no one looks.
        Lily stands by the doorway in her oversized coat, braids undone, wand made of a dried beanstalk.
            "Rai," she says, not bothering to wave. "Mama said yes. I'm in babysitter training."
                "I need a baby," she adds, tapping the floor, "but a baby won't answer back."
                    The beanstalk wand sparks, and a small circle of light opens beside your socks.
                        "One evening," Lily says. "You become six. I practice. Then you're seventeen again."
                            "The magic remembers your words, your choices, and your name. I only get to boss you about juice and blankets."
                                "Also," she says, "if I do it badly, you may tell me. That is part of the test."
                                    The light pulses softly, smelling of honey and rain.
                                        Lily crosses her arms, chin up, but her eyes ask a very honest question.
                                            "Well? Are you in, big brother?"
```
